researchNote: W3.7 era-native research (2026-10-11, GitHub REST API evidence: stars/archived/pushed_at queried live). Carry-over rows are carried from the frozen catalog-v1.json research with per-lane compatibility notes rewritten and per-expansion dates re-verified against the frozen source. Candidates without a well-evidenced GitHub home are deliberately ABSENT. Round 3 (R5-6): VoiceOver 059 demoted to reference on this lane - the upstream TBC & WotLK sound packs are WIP.
flavorNote: The built-in AndroidPort controller UI ships for the vanilla 1.12.1 client only and is deliberately absent here (owner decision, completion-plan table #8). Reference-grade rows (WoW VoiceOver, FonzAppraiser) are listed for research but their installs are disabled on this lane — the upstream artifacts do not match this flavor's accepted interface set or the required per-era data packs are not yet published. Installable add-ons project exactly as on the vanilla lane, and archives whose ## Interface does not match this flavor's accepted set fail closed.

addons.name: pfUI
addons.description: Full replacement UI: unit frames, action bars, bags, nameplates, cast bars, QoL and extensive configuration.
addons.version: No formal GitHub release; use latest master
addons.communitySignal: Very high - repeatedly recommended on r/wowservers; 406 GitHub stars
addons.compatibilityNotes: Repo archived 2026-06-01; the native 1.12 UI ships a first-class 2.4.3 theme - pinned frozen versions, honestly documented as archived upstream.

addons.name: pfQuest
addons.description: Quest database with map integration: quest markers, item tooltips, and a searchable database.
addons.version: No formal GitHub release; use latest master
addons.communitySignal: Very high - repeatedly recommended; long-running default quest helper
addons.compatibilityNotes: Repo archived 2026-06-01; the 2.4.3 database ships in-tree - pinned frozen versions, honestly documented as archived upstream.

addons.name: ShaguTweaks
addons.description: QoL tweaks over the stock UI: buff/bar improvements, map keys, chat fixes.
addons.communitySignal: High - repeatedly recommended as an essential QoL bundle
addons.compatibilityNotes: Archived upstream; the 2.4.3 module set is included in the frozen repo - pinned frozen versions, honestly documented as archived upstream.

addons.name: WoW VoiceOver
addons.description: AI-narrated quest text: the client speaks quest objectives and lore as you accept and progress quests.
addons.communitySignal: High / modern project; the TBC & WotLK sound packs are WIP upstream
addons.compatibilityNotes: R5-6 (code-red round 3): the upstream TBC & WotLK sound packs are marked WIP — no AI_VoiceOverData_TBC/WotLK asset exists in any release, so the era-routed resolver fails loud. Demoted to reference-grade for this lane until upstream publishes the packs; the era-parameterized resolver and validator are implemented and will accept the packs when they ship.

addons.name: FonzAppraiser
addons.description: Loot valuation: vendor/auction price hints and multi-item appraisal in tooltips.
addons.communitySignal: Niche but active and GitHub-topic visible
addons.compatibilityNotes: Active upstream, but the DEFAULT branch declares '## Interface: 30300' only — this lane's fail-closed validator refuses the default-ref download on a 20400 client (R5-5). Install requires a 2.4.3-era branch or release pinned manually; listed as reference-grade for the tbc lane until an upstream tbc ref exists.

addons.name: AtlasLoot Enhanced (TBC)
addons.description: Loot tables for dungeons, raids and PvP: browse every drop from the map or tooltips.
addons.communitySignal: Niche - GitHub-visible fork of the classic AtlasLoot line
addons.compatibilityNotes: Complete TBC 2.4.3 client version; upstream pushed last 2019-11-24 (2 GitHub stars) - a frozen reference database, not a maintained project.

addons.name: Postal (TBC)
addons.description: Mailbox tools: open-all, bulk send and inbox summaries.
addons.compatibilityNotes: Dedicated 2.4.3 port of the classic Postal mailbox suite; upstream pushed last 2023-08-10 (1 GitHub star).

gatefix_note: Code-red round 1 (R5-5): row 068 (FonzAppraiser) demoted to REFERENCE — the upstream default branch (sole branch 'main') declares '## Interface: 30300' only, so the 20400 lane's fail-closed validator refuses the download; the previous copy promised a working TBC install.

recommendationReasons.059: Reference-grade on this lane: the era-matching sound pack is WIP upstream. Listed for the lore research value; the install will be enabled when the pack ships.
recommendationReasons.002: Standalone quest database that reduces map-search and keyboard friction on a 5.5-inch display.
recommendationReasons.001: Full replacement UI whose 2.4.3 theme keeps the Blizzard layout while consolidating bars, bags and nameplates for one-hand play.
